fact: The Direction générale des impôts says its e-services portal, launched 23 May 2024 in Cotonou for small businesses and individuals, lets taxpayers declare income online.
The Direction générale des impôts describes the e-services portal as a portal for online declaration and payment (télépaiement) of taxes, with land taxes payable online, since 23 May 2024.
The government says a single online return for payroll tax and social security contributions was launched on 3 February 2020 on the eservices.impots.bj platform.
The government says the single payroll tax and social security contribution return is followed by online payment on the e-services platform, launched 3 February 2020.
